summary: Every finding the fix report claims FIXED is fixed on the current head, verified by reading the code (not just trusting the report) and by re-running the cells: SPEC-1001-A (en.json:895 now reads 'Showing {shown} of {total} cash accounts, in account code order.', no more 'largest first'), SPEC-1002-A (client-cash-set-dialog.tsx:155 `const isEdit = hasPublishedSet || currentSet?.publishedVersionId != null;`), SPEC-1002-B (the seeding effect now keys off `open` and clears selection/date/refusal/op-key on close, guarded behind isEdit, first-publish face untouched), and STD-1 (new apps/web/components/firm/client-home/composition-cells.tsx holds CompositionAccountCell/CompositionEntriesCell/entryHref, imported by both client-cash-trend.tsx and client-income-expense-chart.tsx). The seven note-level findings left as-is (SPEC-1002-C, SPEC-1002-D, SPEC-1001-B, SPEC-1002-E, SPEC-958-A, STD-2, STD-3) still carry the same reasoning on this head and none is above minor, so none blocks acceptance. Nothing else broke: full gate chain re-run clean, including tests, typecheck, lint-as-CI-sees-it, and the lane's own Playwright triple.
